notes.sowing: Start seeds indoors 4 to 6 weeks before planting out, {cm:0.6} deep, at {c:24} to {c:29}. Plant out 2 to 4 weeks after your last frost, about a week after tomatoes, setting the stem deep. Grow at least two plants: a single plant rarely sets fruit.
notes.care: Stake or cage the sprawling plants, which take more room than tomatoes. They cope with heat and dry spells, but flowers drop above {c:32} or below {c:13}. Water deeply once or twice a week.
notes.harvest: Pick when the fruit fills its papery husk but is still green and firm. Harvest weekly with the husks on. Soft, yellowing fruit is overripe and splits.
